claim: Survey of the leveraged/inverse-ETF rebalancing-flow literature (Lenkey 2024, AIMSPress Quantitative Finance and Economics, open access). The literature consistently reports statistically significant associations between ETF rebalancing demand and late-day returns and volatility, but most papers suffer potentially serious methodological errors and the economic associations appear insignificant; concerns raised by policymakers are not supported by the overall empirical evidence.
